cp.execFile("git", …) used to consult/update ignore state for the Ensemble meta-resources folder; fixed git subcommands with the workspace root as cwd plus the meta-resources relative path. No Chat-private or provider data reaches the spawned process.

The CLI provider runner spawns configured agent CLIs (plus where.exe/which resolution, auth checks, and process-tree cleanup) and hands them workspace/task paths by design — the definitional unresolved dynamic consumer. Plan boundaries already constrain it: general-workspace CLI processes are unsupported for preflight/edit execution, CLI runners are excluded from edit execution, and the runnerV1 cohort replaces its artifact-destination protocol with bounded stdout capture (no artifact/result path in any V1 request, AC-RUNNER-01/02).

Spawns CLI provider model-listing commands (cp.spawn with manual timeout + killProcessTree). Command and arguments come from static provider definitions; no task or workspace paths are passed. Inventoried because a spawned process can still read the environment it runs in.
Spawns taskkill for process-tree termination of CLI provider children; arguments are PIDs only, never paths.

Spawns package-manager check scripts (verified checks: locator resolution via execFileSync, then spawn of pnpm/npm run … in the publish-scope cwd). Consumes workspace-root/publish-scope paths as cwd; spawned checks can read the whole workspace, which is why the row also carries diagnostics/artifactReadWrite sinks and stays behind this evidence until the classifier lands.

OS desktop-notification helper (cp.execFile of the platform notifier with a 15s timeout). Arguments are notification title/body strings; sanitized-diagnostics classification applies to what may enter them — no paths or private payloads are passed.

Spawns git for repository info (branch/remote discovery) with the workspace root as cwd and fixed subcommands; feeds Commit/Push and publish-scope decisions. The git cohort's index/privacy checks (§2.4) are the enforcement point for what may be staged.

Evidence refresh (this round, plan §4.6/§4.7): classifyMetaRoot gained a new read-only workspace.fs call site (verifyJournalFileEntryV1, already present in an earlier round but never re-baselined) and the deletionPending check (hasLiveDeletionJournalV1) reads only through taskDeletionIntentStoreV1.ts's own WorkflowFileStoreV1-mediated store, not workspace.fs directly — still purely read-only, still no promotion/adoption/provider invocation.

Retry/Open/Adopt-and-Retry/Safe Delete recovery commands (plan §§4.4-4.7) for a `status: "creating"` task row: reads task.md/task-progress.json via workspace.fs to build journal/sentinel entries and revalidate before mutating, and writes task.md (Retry only, never overwriting an existing one) plus deletes the folder's own files (Safe Delete only, after durable deleteRequested journaling and immediate-before-mutation revalidation). Every mutating path is gated on a fresh reclassification taken immediately beforehand; adoption (Adopt-and-Retry, Safe Delete's preservable branch) is itself journaled via taskAdoptionIntentStoreV1.ts before any sentinel commit.

Chat cohort, executable-order step 8: activate() now creates the extension's global-storage directory via vscode.workspace.fs.createDirectory(context.globalStorageUri) before configuring the workflow private-storage root — VS Code does not create that directory automatically, and the private-storage root (chat-transactions/, chat-recovery/) is provisioned under it. Best-effort (logs and continues on failure); no task or Chat-private path is involved, only the extension's own storage directory.
